Checks if two planes are co-planar within tolerance.

**Panel:** Comma → Util · **Nickname:** `Co-Planar?`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Plane A | `A` | Plane | Item |  | First vector. |
| Plane A | `B` | Plane | Item |  | Second vector. |
| Tolerance | `Tol` | Number | Item | `RhinoDoc.ActiveDoc?.ModelAbsoluteTolerance ?? 1e-2` | Distance tolerance |
| Angle Tolerance | `ATol` | Number | Item | `RhinoDoc.ActiveDoc?.ModelAngleToleranceDegrees?? 1.0` | Angular tolerance in degrees (°) |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Relation | `R` | Integer | Item | 1 = coplanar & co-direction (normals aligned), -1 = coplanar & opposite (normals reversed), 0 = not coplanar. |
